purpose: Fix L1 audit P1 #5 (RPC endpoint credentials and httpx URL logging), #6 (G-7 passes when prompt directories are missing), #7 (CI does not run the drift checks), #8 (CI trusts PR-controlled lint and type config), and #9 (realized-basis daily-loss halt mixes bases).
plan: Refuse URLs with userinfo, key-named parameters, or opaque path tokens at config load; quiet httpx and httpcore logs to WARNING. G-7 fails closed on a missing prompt or template directory. CI runs make check and overlays the base pyproject.toml and Makefile. Realized-basis halt compares day-start plus realized against the same basis.
rollback_plan: Revert the commit on bot-02-risk/l1-p1-risk. Expected recovery time: about 10 minutes (estimate, not measured). No schema or data migration. Endpoint guard returns to scheme-only validation; CI returns to the prior step list.

claims.claim: An RPC endpoint URL with userinfo, a key-named parameter, or an opaque path token is refused at config load. The error names the setting only and never echoes the value.
httpx and httpcore log lines are kept at WARNING, so request URLs with path or query credentials are not logged at INFO.
Under the realized basis the daily-loss halt compares day-start plus realized against the day-start baseline. An unrealized swing alone does not halt. The total basis is unchanged.
G-7 reports a problem when a prompt, prompt-assembled or agents directory is missing, instead of printing a note.
CI runs make check, which includes the drift commands and scripts/check.sh, after overlaying the base pyproject.toml and Makefile.

unverified: The CI overlay has been tested locally against a depth-1 clone, not on GitHub. The real ci.yml run is unverified.
uv.lock, scripts/*.py, scripts/check.sh and assemble-prompts.sh are still PR-controlled and not overlaid. Outside the named targets.
Realized basis also feeds breakers, sizing caps and drawdown. Drawdown still compares against the total-basis peak. Not changed.
The G-7 template directory was repointed from grokbot/templates to agents, because grokbot/templates is stale and fail-closed would break G-7 on main. This is a judgment call for the owner.
